neighbours.label: ' going' after an industry or system as subject ('The global economy is going', 'Japanese tea is going'); ' going' after a person or vehicle stays lower.
fire: The auto industry is going through a hard period.
Our health system is going through major reforms.
World trade is going through a slow patch.
The film business is going through big changes.
The publishing world is going through upheaval.
Their banking sector is going through a crisis.
The whole region is going through rapid change.
The farm economy is going through a long decline.
quiet: The auto mechanic is going to his lunch break.
Our school bus is going past major roads.
My neighbor is going through a short tunnel.
The film crew is going to Ohio in June.
The delivery van is going around the block.
Their youngest son is going to camp.
The whole family is going to the beach.
The farm truck is going down a long road.

short: ' going' after an industry or system
notes: Probes: ' going' 0.25-0.94. 'The store was going to close' 0.35, so ' going' of a business leaks. 'bus going through' 0.12, 'going to the store' 0.07. ' has' 0.19-0.20 did not separate and is commoner on the card than ' going', so expect `partial`; ' literature' 0.53 is not covered. The model can't see 'through' at ' going', so only the subject differs. The output direction promotes ' undergo', ' experience'.
